prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent game pet concept for a native Canvas Chinese Journey to the West side-scrolling game at 960x540. Make ONE isolated full-body character, right-facing three-quarter SIDE VIEW, centered, no environment, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no watermark, genuinely transparent background. Premium hand-painted 2D chibi illustration with clean dark brown contours, cel-shaded forms, restrained painterly interior texture, warm highlights and rich shaded volumes, readable silhouette at 40 pixels high. Cute rounded lively spirit animal, NOT realistic, not flat primitive shapes, not 3D plastic, not an anime human. All body parts, tail, ears, wings entirely inside canvas with transparent margin. Compact proportions, expressive clear face, natural anatomy. Subject: a small clever spiritual monkey, honey-brown fluffy fur, cream peach-shaped monkey face and rounded muzzle, bright amber eyes with confident playful smile, round ears, big head about half body height, short plump torso, clearly bent little arms and paws, one thick curled tail to the left, compact feet. Small gold cloud headband and short vermilion red neck scarf, body remains mostly fur. Light ready-to-follow stance, one foot forward, paws relaxed, no weapon. Strong monkey identity, tender and spirited, asymmetrical pose.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: original transparent full-body Wukong outfit concept for a Chinese Journey to the West side-scrolling 2D game. Input image 1 is this project's original Wukong modular illustration: identity and painting reference. Reassemble this character as ONE isolated complete full-body Monkey King facing RIGHT in a 3/4 SIDE view, wearing a coordinated refined new gold and vermilion war armor set. Preserve the reference's clearly monkey face, pointed honey-brown cheek fur, brows, muzzle, confident heroic eyes, hand-painted 2D quality, NOT a human boy. Make dignified heroic chibi at about 2.8 heads tall excluding small crown ornaments. Large readable warm monkey face, modest gold cloud-scroll crown with a central red cabochon that keeps ears and eyes uncovered. Gold rounded shoulder plates, graphite-blue lamellar chest with gold trim and clear red straps, red waist sash, layered short gold-edged skirt armor over subtle tiger-fur underskirt, articulated bracers and compact black-and-gold boots, short flowing red cape behind. A small jade pendant at the waist is an outfit detail, not a new item. Ruyi staff with solid dark reddish-brown shaft, beautifully formed gold end sleeves with simple raised cloud scrolls, distinct narrow grip bands. Natural relaxed ready stance, two grounded feet separated, one forearm bent to hold the staff center near shoulder, fingers visibly wrapping grip; staff carried diagonally behind torso with both ends fully visible and face completely unobstructed. Preserve recognizable hero proportion, clear hands/elbows and clothing joints suitable for later animation. Premium cohesive cel shaded painted volumes, disciplined contours, warm metallic gold planes and cool dark undersides, readable silhouette at 76px BODY height. Full body, tail, staff, cape entirely within canvas, generous 6% transparent padding. Truly transparent background, no ground, no cast shadow, no aura, no flame, no text, no decorative frame, no other characters or floating equipment, no photorealism, no 3D plastic, no extra fingers or hands.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: original transparent Ruyi staff equipment concept and inventory icon. Input image is our project's original Monkey King costume concept, use its staff design as the edit target. Isolate and render ONE COMPLETE STRAIGHT Ruyi gold-banded staff by itself, laid horizontally across the canvas, perfectly straight clean axis from left to right, both matching rounded gold caps fully visible. No monkey or hands or other armor. Preserve the same vermilion-dark-red dense wooden/metal shaft and sculpted warm gold end sleeves with simple raised Chinese cloud scroll motif; make premium 2D cel shaded hand-painted illustration matching the input. Staff overall length to maximum diameter ratio approximately 13:1; end sleeves comprise about 16 percent of length each, narrow gold rings delimit the sleeves, middle long grip shaft restrained with small wrapping seams, no hilt, no sword blade, no spikes, no ribbon, no gem, no aura. Strong readable value separation of gold ends and dark red shaft for a 48x48 diagonal inventory icon and 90px long in-game weapon. Subtle warm top-plane highlight, dark lower shade, confident dark-brown outlines. Centered single object, generous padding on ALL sides, canvas landscape. Genuinely transparent background, no text, no watermark, no ground/shadow, no ornamental frame. This is an original asset, no existing game material.
